content: We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (product) reproduces the Still-Gennari HWE reaction retrosynthetically. The product SMILES is given: "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". This appears to be a cyclic sugar derivative with a side chain containing a Z-alkene with an ester. The reaction described: carbon-carbon double bond formed, carbon-oxygen formed, carbon-phosphorus bond broken, carbon-carbon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken, triple bond of alkyne changed to single bond. So the forward reaction is a Still-Gennari HWE: aldehyde + phosphonate ester -> Z-alkene + phosphate byproduct. In retrosynthesis, we break the C=C double bond to give an aldehyde and a phosphonate ester (with electron-withdrawing groups). The template likely corresponds to HWE reaction (Still-Gennari). We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional groups formed: "C-C double bonds" and "carboxylic esters". The tool expects exact names from list. The list includes "C-C double bonds" and "carboxylic esters". So we should use those. Also functional groups broken: maybe "phosphonates"? Not in list. But we can specify broken groups maybe "phosphonates"? Not in list. Could leave null. Also bonds broken: carbon-phosphorus, carbon-carbon, carbon-oxygen; but we can leave null. Let's search with functional_groups_formed: ["C-C double bonds","carboxylic esters"].
